name: io.github.st412m/cheap-eyes
title: cheap-eyes
description: Hands bulk reading to cheap OpenRouter models, masks secrets, checks each answer against the source

environmentVariables.name: CHEAP_EYES_OPENROUTER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenRouter API key (give it its own daily limit on openrouter.ai)

environmentVariables.name: CHEAP_EYES_READ_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Folders the server may read, absolute, joined by ; on Windows and : elsewhere; optional (default: the project folder)

environmentVariables.name: CHEAP_EYES_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path of a JSON settings file; optional (every setting has a default)
